  PROBLEM: Exporting empty classification values through the heredoc writes a newline-only env var, so the downstream `-n` check treats “no managed issues” as truthy and suppresses merged PR alerts.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers observed the same empty-value round-trip bug; it affects the common no-managed-issues path and can also poison the no-linked-issues early-exit path, causing false alert suppression.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:514-531 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The fallback body-lookup path checks only for `Managed by: AI Orchestrator` and can miss managed issues that are label-only.
  WHY: The primary classifier accepts either the `ai:orchestrator-managed` label or the body marker, so the fallback can misclassify orchestrator-owned issues and fire spurious alerts when classification is incomplete.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  EVIDENCE: The new tests do not cover the label-only managed child in the `ORCHESTRATOR_CLASSIFICATION_COMPLETE=false` fallback path, so the fallback classifier can still misclassify orchestrator-managed issues.
- requirement: "Export or thread forward the earlier classifier result (for example `MANAGED_ISSUES`, `TRACKING_ISSUES`, or a derived boolean) so the merged-alert step can reuse it. ... The common merged-alert path no longer performs one body GET per linked issue."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml (both the classifier step and "Send PR merged Telegram alert" step)

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:194, 197, 200 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `printf '%s\n' "${VAR:-}"` in the heredoc export makes empty classification values newline-only, so the downstream `-n` check treats no managed issues as truthy and suppresses merged alerts.
  WHY: A newline-only `MANAGED_ISSUES` survives the `$GITHUB_ENV` round-trip, and the merged-alert step then sets `IS_ORCHESTRATED="true"` instead of sending Telegram alerts.
Requirement: "Update `tests/test_issue_pr_status_payload_fallback_contract.py` to cover the reused classification contract."
Expected change site: tests/test_issue_pr_status_payload_fallback_contract.py — the new `test_orchestrator_classification_is_exported_for_downstream_reuse` and `test_merged_alert_reuses_exported_managed_classification_before_body_lookup_fallback` tests
Evidence of absence: The new tests assert that export statements exist in the workflow YAML text, but they do NOT assert that the exported values remain truly empty when the source variables are empty. There is no test that verifies an empty `MANAGED_ISSUES` survives the `$GITHUB_ENV` multiline heredoc round-trip as an empty string.
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

  WHY: The merged-alert step's `[ -n "${MANAGED_ISSUES:-}" ]` check becomes true, causing `IS_ORCHESTRATED="true"` and skipping Telegram alerts.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:191-207 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The same newline-export pattern also affects `LINKED_ISSUE_NUMBERS` and `TRACKING_ISSUES`, leaving newline-only values for future consumers.
  WHY: Any future `-n` guard on those exports would misread empty state as non-empty, creating false positives.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:514-528 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fallback body lookup ignores the `ai:orchestrator-managed` label and only greps the issue body marker.
  WHY: If classification is incomplete, a label-only managed issue will be misclassified and trigger spurious alerts or missed closes.
